extraction_spec: Extract all government job notifications from the main table on this page. For each row extract: post_date (the date the notification was posted), recruitment_board (the organization name like UPSC, SSC, etc.), post_name (the job title/position name), qualification (required educational qualification), advt_no (advertisement number if available), last_date (the deadline to apply), and detail_url (the href link to the full notification page). Return as a JSON array of objects.
